<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>鹈鹕骑自行车</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: linear-gradient(#8ed3f0, #d6f0fb 70%, #bfe6c1 70%);
    font-family: sans-serif;
  }
  .stage {
    width: min(92vw, 900px);
    height: auto;
    display: block;
  }

  /* 车轮旋转 */
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  .wheel {
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: center;
    animation: spin 1.1s linear infinite;
  }

  /* 鹈鹕保持稳定，脚由 JS 精确踩踏板（动感由车轮/踏板/云/地面体现） */
  .pelican { animation: none; }
  .wing { /* 保持稳定握把 */ }

  /* 云飘动 */
  @keyframes drift { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-900px); } }
  .clouds { animation: drift 22s linear infinite; }

  /* 地面滚动条纹 */
  @keyframes ground { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-120px); } }
  .groundline { animation: ground 0.6s linear infinite; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg class="stage" viewBox="0 0 900 460" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <g class="clouds" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9">

      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="42" ry="24"/>

    </g>
    <g transform="translate(820,90)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="38" ry="22"/>
      <ellipse cx="30" cy="8" rx="30" ry="18"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(1220,70)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="42" ry="24"/>
      <ellipse cx="34" cy="8" rx="34" ry="20"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(1620,55)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="46" ry="26"/>
      <ellipse cx="38" cy="10" rx="36" ry="22"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- 地面滚动条纹 -->
  <g class="groundline" stroke="#8fbf7a" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="40 80">
    <line x1="0" y1="400" x2="1020" y2="400"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 自行车 ============ -->
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- 后轮 -->
    <g class="wheel">
      <circle cx="250" cy="330" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="10"/>
      <circle cx="250" cy="330" r="70" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="4"/>
      <g stroke="#777" stroke-width="3">
        <line x1="250" y1="260" x2="250" y2="400"/>
        <line x1="180" y1="330" x2="320" y2="330"/>
        <line x1="200" y1="280" x2="300" y2="380"/>
        <line x1="300" y1="280" x2="200" y2="380"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="250" cy="330" r="8" fill="#333"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 前轮 -->
    <g class="wheel">
      <circle cx="620" cy="330" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="10"/>
      <circle cx="620" cy="330" r="70" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="4"/>
      <g stroke="#777" stroke-width="3">
        <line x1="620" y1="260" x2="620" y2="400"/>
        <line x1="550" y1="330" x2="690" y2="330"/>
        <line x1="570" y1="280" x2="670" y2="380"/>
        <line x1="670" y1="280" x2="570" y2="380"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="620" cy="330" r="8" fill="#333"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 车架 -->
    <g stroke="#d63b3b" stroke-width="12" fill="none">
      <line x1="250" y1="330" x2="430" y2="330"/>
      <line x1="430" y1="330" x2="360" y2="210"/>
      <line x1="250" y1="330" x2="360" y2="210"/>
      <line x1="360" y1="210" x2="430" y2="330"/>
      <line x1="430" y1="330" x2="620" y2="330"/>
      <line x1="620" y1="330" x2="560" y2="180"/>
      <line x1="430" y1="330" x2="560" y2="180"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 车座 -->
    <rect x="335" y="196" width="60" height="18" rx="8" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
    <!-- 车把 -->
    <path d="M560,180 q40,-6 62,18" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="10"/>
    <!-- 链条 -->
    <circle cx="430" cy="330" r="26" fill="none" stroke="#666" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="250" y1="318" x2="430" y2="314" stroke="#666" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="250" y1="342" x2="430" y2="346" stroke="#666" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 踏板曲柄（JS 驱动旋转） -->
    <line id="crank1" x1="430" y1="330" x2="470" y2="372" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="8"/>
    <line id="crank2" x1="430" y1="330" x2="390" y2="288" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="8"/>
    <rect id="pedal1" x="0" y="0" width="34" height="12" rx="4" fill="#111"/>
    <rect id="pedal2" x="0" y="0" width="34" height="12" rx="4" fill="#111"/>

  </g>

  <!-- ============ 鹈鹕（骑行姿势） ============ -->
  <g class="pelican">
    <!-- 尾巴（臀部后下方） -->
    <path d="M362,215 q-48,10 -58,42 q36,3 72,-20 z" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e3e3e3" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 腿踩踏板（JS 驱动，脚跟着踏板转） -->
    <g stroke="#f2a93b" stroke-width="10" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
      <path id="leg1" d="M372,208 Q350,290 410,352"/>
      <path id="leg2" d="M378,208 Q440,290 456,316"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 脚掌踩踏板 -->
    <ellipse id="foot1" cx="410" cy="352" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#f5c451" stroke="#e0a52e" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse id="foot2" cx="456" cy="316" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#f5c451" stroke="#e0a52e" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- 身体躯干（前倾骑行） -->
    <path d="M356,214 Q348,152 415,146 Q488,140 500,168 Q496,206 440,217 Q388,224 356,214 Z"

    <!-- 翅膀（伸直握住车把） -->
    <path class="wing" d="M482,160 Q560,172 602,186 L598,206 Q540,196 482,182 Z"
          fill="#f3f3f3" stroke="#dcdcdc" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- 翅膀末端爪子握把 -->
    <ellipse cx="600" cy="196" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#f5c451" stroke="#e0a52e" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- 脖子 -->
    <path d="M478,158 q44,-10 60,-52" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="32" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- 头 -->
    <circle cx="544" cy="92" r="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e3e3e3" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 大嘴(鹈鹕特征) -->
    <path d="M552,86 q98,8 116,32 q-68,22 -112,-4 z" fill="#f5c451" stroke="#e0a52e" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- 喉囊 -->
    <path d="M556,104 q56,38 52,74 q-40,8 -66,-30 z" fill="#f7d074" stroke="#e0a52e" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 眼睛 -->
    <circle cx="540" cy="84" r="6" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
    <circle cx="542" cy="82" r="2" fill="#fff"/>

    <!-- 头顶小羽 -->
    <path d="M536,64 q-6,-16 6,-22 q2,12 -2,22 z" fill="#f5c451"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 速度线 -->
  <g stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="120" y1="250" x2="60" y2="250"/>
    <line x1="140" y1="290" x2="70" y2="290"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="330" x2="60" y2="330"/>
  </g>

</svg>

<script>
(function () {
  // 曲柄中心、臂长、臀部位置
  var C = { x: 430, y: 330 };
  var r = 42;                 // 曲柄臂长（脚到中心距离）
  var H = { x: 372, y: 208 }; // 臀部（腿根部）
  var period = 1100;          // 与车轮 spin 同步：1.1s 一圈

  var crank1 = document.getElementById('crank1');
  var crank2 = document.getElementById('crank2');
  var pedal1 = document.getElementById('pedal1');
  var pedal2 = document.getElementById('pedal2');
  var leg1 = document.getElementById('leg1');
  var leg2 = document.getElementById('leg2');
  var foot1 = document.getElementById('foot1');
  var foot2 = document.getElementById('foot2');

  // 根据臀部 H 与脚 P 计算弯曲的腿路径（膝盖向侧方弯）
  function legPath(h, p, side) {
    var mx = (h.x + p.x) / 2, my = (h.y + p.y) / 2;
    var dx = p.x - h.x, dy = p.y - h.y;
    var len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    var nx = -dy / len, ny = dx / len;   // 法向量
    var bend = 20;
    var kx = mx + nx * bend * side, ky = my + ny * bend * side;
    return 'M' + h.x + ',' + h.y + ' Q' + kx.toFixed(1) + ',' + ky.toFixed(1) + ' ' +
           p.x.toFixed(1) + ',' + p.y.toFixed(1);
  }

  function update(t) {
    var angle = ((t % period) / period) * Math.PI * 2;
    var cos = Math.cos(angle), sin = Math.sin(angle);

    // 两个踏板末端（相差 180°）
    var P1 = { x: C.x + r * cos, y: C.y + r * sin };
    var P2 = { x: C.x - r * cos, y: C.y - r * sin };

    // 曲柄臂
    crank1.setAttribute('x2', P1.x); crank1.setAttribute('y2', P1.y);
    crank2.setAttribute('x2', P2.x); crank2.setAttribute('y2', P2.y);
    // 踏板块（画在踏板末端，中心对齐）
    pedal1.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (P1.x - 17) + ',' + (P1.y - 6) + ')');
    pedal2.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (P2.x - 17) + ',' + (P2.y - 6) + ')');

    // 腿跟随
    leg1.setAttribute('d', legPath(H, P1, -1));
    leg2.setAttribute('d', legPath(H, P2, 1));
    // 脚掌踩在踏板末端
    foot1.setAttribute('cx', P1.x); foot1.setAttribute('cy', P1.y);
    foot2.setAttribute('cx', P2.x); foot2.setAttribute('cy', P2.y);

    requestAnimationFrame(update);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(update);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
